title: decode.rs: filename trailing whitespace not trimmed (diverged from scan)
description: decode.rs line 118 did not trim_end() on filename, while scan.rs line 139 did. A begin line with trailing spaces produced different filenames from decode vs scan on the same input. Fixed: added rposition trailing-whitespace strip. Added regression test.
close_reason: Fixed: decode.rs now trims trailing whitespace from filename. Regression test added.
